nodes.doc:
**The discrete Vorob'ev theorem**: a cover's base structure is acyclic exactly when local
pairwise consistency always forces a global structure, i.e. every pairwise-consistent family of
nonempty local relations on it glues.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic 𝒞 ↔
    ∀ (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι fun x => ZMod 2)),
      List.map (fun x => x.team) fam = 𝒞.toList →
        HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam → (∀ L ∈ fam, L.rel.Nonempty) → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc:
**The order-free amalgamation theorem**: an acyclic cover forces every pairwise-consistent
family with duplicate-free teams to glue. The base structure, acyclicity, is decidable, so the
sufficiency is machine-checkable.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] [inst_2 : Fintype ι]
  [(i : ι) → Fintype (X i)] [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (X i)] (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam →
    (List.map (fun x => x.team) fam).Nodup →
      HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic (List.map (fun x => x.team) fam).toFinset → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc: The family-level running intersection property reads only the teams.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.RIP fam ↔ HiddenChannelCapacity.RIPCover (List.map (fun x => x.team) fam)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.famCover fam = HiddenChannelCapacity.listCover (List.map (fun x => x.team) fam)

nodes.doc:
**The amalgamation leg**: over a running-intersection cover, a pairwise-consistent family
glues: the base geometry forces the global structure.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] [inst_2 : Fintype ι]
  [(i : ι) → Fintype (X i)] [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (X i)] (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.RIP fam → HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc:
**The amalgamation theorem** (positive Vorob'ev, certificate form): once the cover carries
the running intersection property, the natural join of any pairwise-consistent family realizes
every member exactly, so the base geometry licenses the global structure.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] [inst_2 : Fintype ι]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Fintype (X i)] [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (X i)] (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.RIP fam →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam →
      ∀ L ∈ fam, HiddenChannelCapacity.projS (HiddenChannelCapacity.joinFam fam) L.team = L.rel

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} {fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)}
  {L : HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X}, L ∈ fam → L.team ⊆ HiddenChannelCapacity.famCover fam

nodes.doc:
**The presheaf law**: the restriction map carries the `T`-marginal onto the `S`-marginal.
This is the compatibility any Čech-type complex over the marginal family consumes.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] (κ : Finset ((i : ι) → X i)) {S T : Finset ι}
  (hST : S ⊆ T), Finset.image (Finset.restrict₂ hST) (HiddenChannelCapacity.projS κ T) = HiddenChannelCapacity.projS κ S

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] [inst_2 : Fintype ι]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Fintype (X i)] {fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)} {f : (i : ι) → X i},
  f ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.joinFam fam ↔ ∀ L ∈ fam, L.team.restrict f ∈ L.rel

nodes.doc: Any local configuration extends to a global one, on nonempty parts.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (X i)] (T : Finset ι) (g : (i : ↥T) → X ↑i),
  ∃ f, T.restrict f = g

nodes.doc: Sub-marginalizing an interface marginal composes.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] (L : HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)
  {S T : Finset ι} (hS : S ⊆ T) (hT : T ⊆ L.team), Finset.image (Finset.restrict₂ hS) (L.imarg hT) = L.imarg ⋯

nodes.doc: Gluing is permutation-invariant.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → Fintype (X i)]
  {fam fam' : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)},
  fam'.Perm fam → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam' → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc: A permutation of a mapped list lifts along the map.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {g : α → β} {σ : List β} {l : List α},
  σ.Perm (List.map g l) → ∃ l', l'.Perm l ∧ List.map g l' = σ

nodes.doc: Pairwise consistency is permutation-invariant.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (X i)]
  {fam fam' : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι X)},
  fam'.Perm fam → HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam → HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam'

nodes.doc:
**The CAPSTONE**: a non-acyclic cover hosts a pairwise-consistent family of nonempty
local relations that no global structure realizes: the base structure carries what local
consistency cannot.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic 𝒞 →
    ∃ fam,
      List.map (fun x => x.team) fam = 𝒞.toList ∧
        HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam ∧ (∀ L ∈ fam, L.rel.Nonempty) ∧ ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc:
**The ear-free dichotomy**: an ear-free cover is non-conformal or contains a chordless
cycle. Dirac's lemma on the shared vertices produces a simplicial shared vertex, and the
one-step GYO collapse turns it into an ear.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.EarFree 𝒞 → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Conformal 𝒞 ∨ ∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞 l

nodes.doc: An ear-free cover has a shared vertex: every team has nonempty boundary.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.EarFree 𝒞 → (HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞).Nonempty

nodes.doc:
**The one-step GYO collapse**: in a conformal cover, a simplicial shared vertex yields an
ear — every team containing it has boundary inside the team covering its closed shared
neighborhood.

hypotheses.name: hsimp
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ x ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞,
  ∀ y ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞,
    HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v x → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v y → x ≠ y → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x y

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Conformal 𝒞 →
    ∀ {v : ι},
      v ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞 →
        (∀ x ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞,
            ∀ y ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞,
              HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v x →
                HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v y → x ≠ y → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x y) →
          ∃ T ∈ 𝒞, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsEarOf 𝒞 T

nodes.doc: A team's boundary is its shared part.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {T : Finset ι},
  T ∈ 𝒞 → T ∩ HiddenChannelCapacity.coverU (𝒞.erase T) = T ∩ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {v : ι},
  v ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.shared 𝒞 ↔ ∃ T ∈ 𝒞, ∃ T' ∈ 𝒞, T ≠ T' ∧ v ∈ T ∧ v ∈ T'

nodes.doc:
**Dirac's lemma, strong form**: in a chordless-cycle-free adjacency structure, every
vertex set is a clique or contains two nonadjacent simplicial vertices.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  (¬∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞 l) →
    ∀ (S : Finset ι),
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x y) ∨
        ∃ u w,
          HiddenChannelCapacity.SimpIn 𝒞 S u ∧
            HiddenChannelCapacity.SimpIn 𝒞 S w ∧ u ≠ w ∧ ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u w

nodes.doc:
**The assembled-cycle contradiction**: two length-minimal x-y connectors through
disjoint, mutually non-adjacent sides cannot coexist with chordless-cycle-freeness when
x and y are non-adjacent.

hypotheses.name: hABdisj
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (v : ι), QA v → QB v → False

hypotheses.name: hABnadj
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (u v : ι), QA u → QB v → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v

hypotheses.name: hvA
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ pA, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v

hypotheses.name: hminA
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
    pA.length ≤ q.length

hypotheses.name: hvB
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ pB, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v

hypotheses.name: hminB
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
    pB.length ≤ q.length

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)},
  (¬∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞 l) →
    ∀ {QA QB : ι → Prop} {x y : ι},
      x ≠ y →
        ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x y →
          ¬QB x →
            ¬QB y →
              (∀ (v : ι), QA v → QB v → False) →
                (∀ (u v : ι), QA u → QB v → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v) →
                  ∀ (pA : List ι),
                    List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) pA →
                      pA.Nodup →
                        pA.head? = some x →
                          pA.getLast? = some y →
                            (∀ v ∈ pA, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
                              (∀ (q : List ι),
                                  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                                      q.Nodup ∧
                                        q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QA v) →
                                    pA.length ≤ q.length) →
                                ∀ (pB : List ι),
                                  List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) pB →
                                    pB.Nodup →
                                      pB.head? = some x →
                                        pB.getLast? = some y →
                                          (∀ v ∈ pB, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
                                            (∀ (q : List ι),
                                                (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                                                    q.Nodup ∧
                                                      q.head? = some x ∧
                                                        q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ QB v) →
                                                  pB.length ≤ q.length) →
                                              False

nodes.doc:
**Minimality kills chords**: a length-minimal constrained x-y path has no adjacency
between positions at distance ≥ 2.

hypotheses.name: hvert
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v

hypotheses.name: hmin
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ (q : List ι),
  (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
      q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
    p.length ≤ q.length

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {Q : ι → Prop} {x y : ι} {p : List ι},
  List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) p →
    p.head? = some x →
      p.getLast? = some y →
        (∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
          (∀ (q : List ι),
              (List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) q ∧
                  q.Nodup ∧ q.head? = some x ∧ q.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ q, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v) →
                p.length ≤ q.length) →
            p.Nodup →
              ∀ {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < p.length) (hj : j < p.length), i + 2 ≤ j → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 p[i] p[j]
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {p : List ι} {y : ι}, p.getLast? = some y → ∀ (h0 : 0 < p.length), p[p.length - 1] = y

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v w : ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P v w → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u w

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v : ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P v u
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u : ι}, P u → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u u

nodes.doc: Every vertex on a walk is reachable from its head.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v : ι} {p : List ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.IsWalkOn 𝒞 P p → p.head? = some u → v ∈ p → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} {u v w : ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v w → P w → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u w
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {Q : List ι → Prop}, (∃ p, Q p) → ∃ p, Q p ∧ ∀ (q : List ι), Q q → p.length ≤ q.length

nodes.doc:
A connector: an x-y path with interior inside `Q`, from adjacent entry points and
interior reachability.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {Q : ι → Prop} {x y u₁ u₂ : ι},
  x ≠ y →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u₁ →
      HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 y u₂ →
        HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 Q u₁ u₂ →
          ¬Q x →
            ¬Q y →
              ∃ p,
                List.IsChain (HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞) p ∧
                  p.Nodup ∧ p.head? = some x ∧ p.getLast? = some y ∧ ∀ v ∈ p, v = x ∨ v = y ∨ Q v

nodes.doc:
If `x` has no neighbor reachable from `a` off the separator, then erasing `x` still
separates: the first `x`-occurrence on any violating path has its predecessor reachable
from `a` and adjacent to `x`.

hypotheses.name: hno
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ (u : ι), u ∈ S \ Sep ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a u → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u

hypotheses.name: hsep
hypotheses.pretty: ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a b

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {S Sep : Finset ι} {a b x : ι},
  x ≠ a →
    (∀ (u : ι),
        u ∈ S \ Sep ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a u → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 x u) →
      ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep) a b →
        ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 (fun v => v ∈ S \ Sep.erase x) a b

nodes.doc: Every chained walk contains a duplicate-free path with the same endpoints and vertices.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {P : ι → Prop} (p : List ι),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.IsWalkOn 𝒞 P p →
    ∀ {u v : ι}, p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → HiddenChannelCapacity.ReachOn 𝒞 P u v
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → ι → Prop} {p : List ι}, List.IsChain R p → ∀ (n : ℕ), List.IsChain R (List.drop n p)
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → ι → Prop} {p : List ι}, List.IsChain R p → ∀ (n : ℕ), List.IsChain R (List.take n p)

nodes.doc: Positional form of the head.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {p : List ι} {x : ι}, p.head? = some x → ∀ (h0 : 0 < p.length), p[0] = x
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (l : List ι) {s t : ℕ} (hs : s < l.length) (ht : t < l.length), s = t → l[s] = l[t]
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {u v : ι}, HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 u v → HiddenChannelCapacity.Adj 𝒞 v u

nodes.doc:
**The capstone, modulo the dichotomy**: once every ear-free core is non-conformal or has
a chordless cycle (the Dirac edge, URS D26 L6), every non-Graham-reducible cover hosts the base
structure that licenses the verdict: a pairwise-consistent family of nonempty local relations
that no global structure realizes.

hypotheses.name: hdi
hypotheses.pretty:
∀ 𝒞' ⊆ 𝒞,
  HiddenChannelCapacity.EarFree 𝒞' →
    ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Conformal 𝒞' ∨ ∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞' l

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.GrahamReducible 𝒞 →
    (∀ 𝒞' ⊆ 𝒞,
        HiddenChannelCapacity.EarFree 𝒞' →
          ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Conformal 𝒞' ∨ ∃ l, HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞' l) →
      ∃ fam,
        List.map (fun x => x.team) fam = 𝒞.toList ∧
          HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam ∧ (∀ L ∈ fam, L.rel.Nonempty) ∧ ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam

nodes.doc:
**Chain extraction**: a non-Graham-reducible cover has an ear-free core such that any
vertex set inside the core's cover hosted anywhere in the cover is hosted inside the core.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.GrahamReducible 𝒞 →
    ∃ 𝒞' ⊆ 𝒞,
      HiddenChannelCapacity.EarFree 𝒞' ∧ ∀ w ⊆ HiddenChannelCapacity.coverU 𝒞', (∃ V ∈ 𝒞, w ⊆ V) → ∃ W ∈ 𝒞', w ⊆ W

nodes.doc:
**The clique datum**: a cardinality-minimal non-covered clique yields a clean system.
Minimality covers the erase-sets; non-coveredness is cleanliness; parity closes by counting.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  𝒞.Nonempty →
    ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Conformal 𝒞 →
      ∃ 𝒲,
        𝒲.Nonempty ∧
          (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, w ≠ ∅) ∧
            (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, ∃ T ∈ 𝒞, w ⊆ T) ∧
              (∀ V ∈ 𝒞, ∀ w₁ ∈ 𝒲, ∀ w₂ ∈ 𝒲, w₁ ⊆ V → w₂ ⊆ V → w₁ = w₂) ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum 𝒲 = ∅

nodes.doc: An F2 sum vanishes iff every incidence count is even.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {D : Finset (Finset ι)},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum D = ∅ ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ¬Odd {x ∈ D | i ∈ x}.card

nodes.doc: Membership in an F2 sum is odd incidence.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {D : Finset (Finset ι)} {i : ι},
  i ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum D ↔ Odd {x ∈ D | i ∈ x}.card
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {K : Finset ι} {i j : ι}, i ≠ j → K.erase i ∪ K.erase j = K

nodes.doc: Small cliques are covered: the empty set (nonempty cover), singletons, edges.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)},
  𝒞.Nonempty →
    ∀ {K : Finset ι},
      K ⊆ HiddenChannelCapacity.coverU 𝒞 →
        HiddenChannelCapacity.IsClique 𝒞 K → K.card ≤ 2 → HiddenChannelCapacity.Covered 𝒞 K

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {v : ι},
  v ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.coverU 𝒞 ↔ ∃ T ∈ 𝒞, v ∈ T

nodes.doc: The clean system of a chordless cycle, in finder form.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)} {l : List ι},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.IsChordlessCycle 𝒞 l →
    ∃ 𝒲,
      𝒲.Nonempty ∧
        (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, w ≠ ∅) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, ∃ T ∈ 𝒞, w ⊆ T) ∧
            (∀ V ∈ 𝒞, ∀ w₁ ∈ 𝒲, ∀ w₂ ∈ 𝒲, w₁ ⊆ V → w₂ ⊆ V → w₁ = w₂) ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum 𝒲 = ∅

nodes.doc:
**The cycle sum telescopes**: consecutive pairs of a duplicate-free cyclic list sum to
`∅` over F2 — every vertex lies in exactly two pairs.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (l : List ι),
  l.Nodup → 2 ≤ l.length → HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (HiddenChannelCapacity.cyclePairs l) = ∅

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (l₁ l₂ : List (Finset ι)),
  l₁.length = l₂.length →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (List.zipWith (fun x1 x2 => symmDiff x1 x2) l₁ l₂) =
      symmDiff (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l₁) (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l₂)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {l₁ l₂ : List (Finset ι)},
  l₁.Perm l₂ → HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l₁ = HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l₂
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {a b : ι}, a ≠ b → {a, b} = symmDiff {a} {b}
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (l : List ι), l.Nodup → ∀ (h2 : 2 ≤ l.length) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.length), l[i] ≠ l[(i + 1) % l.length]

**The transfer**: a clean system on a chained ear-free core is a clean system on the full
cover — any team hosting two members routes them into a single core team.

nodes.doc:
**The clean-system obstruction**, the unified consumption theorem of C-ENGINE: a base-side
clean system (a nonempty hosted family of distinct nonempty supports with vanishing F2 sum, no
team hosting two) licenses a verdict on local measurement, a pairwise-consistent family of
nonempty local relations over the whole cover that no global structure realizes. Every witness
rung (chordless cycles, even boundary data, landings, the `H_k` clique parities) differs only as
a FINDER of such a base system.

nodes.doc:
**The affine obstruction engine, packaged**: from a base-side hosted odd dependency (over a
closed coherent system) follows a verdict on local measurement, a family of nonempty local
relations that is pairwise consistent yet realizes no global structure.

hypotheses.name: hco
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V

hypotheses.name: hhost
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ w ∈ D, ∃ V ∈ teams, w ⊆ V

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {teams : List (Finset ι)} {𝒲 : Finset (Finset ι)}
  {c : Finset ι → ZMod 2},
  teams ≠ [] →
    (∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.ClosedAt 𝒲 V) →
      (∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V) →
        ∀ D ⊆ 𝒲,

            ∑ w ∈ D, c w = 1 →
              (∀ w ∈ D, ∃ V ∈ teams, w ⊆ V) →
                HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent (HiddenChannelCapacity.affFam teams 𝒲 c) ∧
                  (∀ L ∈ HiddenChannelCapacity.affFam teams 𝒲 c, L.rel.Nonempty) ∧
                    ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues (HiddenChannelCapacity.affFam teams 𝒲 c)

nodes.doc:
**The obstruction theorem**: a hosted odd dependency (a base-side witness) forecloses every
global structure; any global realizing all the local relations would satisfy every hosted
constraint, and the dependency sums those satisfactions to `0 = 1`.

hypotheses.name: hco
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V

hypotheses.name: hhost
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ w ∈ D, ∃ V ∈ teams, w ⊆ V

  {c : Finset ι → ZMod 2},
  teams ≠ [] →
    (∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V) →
      ∀ D ⊆ 𝒲,
        HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum D = ∅ →
          ∑ w ∈ D, c w = 1 →
            (∀ w ∈ D, ∃ V ∈ teams, w ⊆ V) → ¬HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues (HiddenChannelCapacity.affFam teams 𝒲 c)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (D : Finset (Finset ι)) (f : ι → ZMod 2),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum D) f = ∑ w ∈ D, HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w f

nodes.doc:
Closed coherent affine families are pairwise consistent: both interface marginals ARE the
interface's visible system.

hypotheses.name: hco
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ V ∈ teams, HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V

nodes.doc:
**The exact marginal computation**: the interface marginal of a closed coherent local
structure is exactly the local structure of the interface — the interface sees precisely the
visible constraints.

  HiddenChannelCapacity.ClosedAt 𝒲 V →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V →
      (HiddenChannelCapacity.affLocal V 𝒲 c).imarg hS = (HiddenChannelCapacity.affLocal S 𝒲 c).rel

  w ⊆ S → ∀ (F : ↥V → ZMod 2), HiddenChannelCapacity.wsum S w (Finset.restrict₂ hS F) = HiddenChannelCapacity.wsum V w F

nodes.doc:
The pinned system: hosted constraints of `V` plus a singleton pin at every `S`-coordinate
of a visible-constraint-satisfying trace. Coherent, by closedness.

hypotheses.name: hg
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ w ∈ 𝒲, w ⊆ S → HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w g₀ = c w

nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {V S : Finset ι} {𝒲 : Finset (Finset ι)} {c : Finset ι → ZMod 2},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.ClosedAt 𝒲 V →
    HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V →
      ∀ (g₀ : ι → ZMod 2),
        (∀ w ∈ 𝒲, w ⊆ S → HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w g₀ = c w) →
          HiddenChannelCapacity.SysCoherent
            (HiddenChannelCapacity.hostedList✝ V 𝒲 c ++ List.map (fun i => ({i}, g₀ i)) S.toList)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {V : Finset ι} {𝒲 D : Finset (Finset ι)},
  D ⊆ {x ∈ 𝒲 | x ⊆ V} → HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum D ⊆ V

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {l : List ι},
  l.Nodup → HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (List.map (fun x => {x}) l) = l.toFinset

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (a b : List (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (a ++ b) = symmDiff (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL a) (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL b)
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι], HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL [] = ∅
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (g₀ : ι → ZMod 2) (l : List ι), List.map Prod.snd (List.map (fun i => ({i}, g₀ i)) l) = List.map g₀ l

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (g₀ : ι → ZMod 2) (l : List ι),
  List.map Prod.fst (List.map (fun i => ({i}, g₀ i)) l) = List.map (fun x => {x}) l

nodes.doc: Every local relation of a coherent system is nonempty.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {V : Finset ι} {𝒲 : Finset (Finset ι)} {c : Finset ι → ZMod 2},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V → (HiddenChannelCapacity.affLocal V 𝒲 c).rel.Nonempty

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {V w : Finset ι},
  w ⊆ V → ∀ (f : ι → ZMod 2), HiddenChannelCapacity.wsum V w (V.restrict f) = HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w f

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {V : Finset ι} {𝒲 : Finset (Finset ι)} {c : Finset ι → ZMod 2},
  HiddenChannelCapacity.CoherentAt 𝒲 c V → HiddenChannelCapacity.SysCoherent (HiddenChannelCapacity.hostedList✝ V 𝒲 c)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {l : List (Finset ι)},
  l.Nodup → HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l = HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSum l.toFinset

∀ {ι : Type u_1} (c : Finset ι → ZMod 2) (l : List (Finset ι)),
  List.map Prod.snd (List.map (fun w => (w, c w)) l) = List.map c l
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (c : Finset ι → ZMod 2) (l : List (Finset ι)), List.map Prod.fst (List.map (fun w => (w, c w)) l) = l

nodes.doc:
**The solvability core**: a coherent list-presented parity system has a solution.
Elementary Gaussian elimination, by induction on the list.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (L : List (Finset ι × ZMod 2)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.SysCoherent L → ∃ f, ∀ p ∈ L, HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn p.1 f = p.2

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (w : Finset ι) (l : List (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (w :: l) = symmDiff w (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL l)

nodes.doc:
The Gaussian transform bookkeeping: transforming the x-containing entries by `∆ w₀`
shifts the F2 sum by `w₀` per transformed entry, and the constants by `c₀` likewise.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (x : ι) (w₀ : Finset ι) (c₀ : ZMod 2) (sub : List (Finset ι × ZMod 2)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL
        (List.map Prod.fst (List.map (fun p => if x ∈ p.1 then (symmDiff p.1 w₀, p.2 + c₀) else p) sub)) =
      symmDiff (HiddenChannelCapacity.xorSumL (List.map Prod.fst sub))
        (if List.countP (fun p => decide (x ∈ p.1)) sub % 2 = 1 then w₀ else ∅) ∧
    (List.map Prod.snd (List.map (fun p => if x ∈ p.1 then (symmDiff p.1 w₀, p.2 + c₀) else p) sub)).sum =
      (List.map Prod.snd sub).sum + if List.countP (fun p => decide (x ∈ p.1)) sub % 2 = 1 then c₀ else 0
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (a : Finset ι), symmDiff a ∅ = a

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (w w' : Finset ι) (f : ι → ZMod 2),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn (symmDiff w w') f =
    HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w f + HiddenChannelCapacity.parityOn w' f
∀ (a : ZMod 2), a + a = 0

nodes.doc: **The Graham bridge**: acyclicity is exactly Graham reducibility.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic 𝒞 ↔ HiddenChannelCapacity.GrahamReducible 𝒞

nodes.doc: An RIP order eliminates from the front: its head is an ear and the tail remains RIP.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (order : List (Finset ι)),
  order.Nodup → HiddenChannelCapacity.RIPCover order → HiddenChannelCapacity.GrahamN order.length order.toFinset

  HiddenChannelCapacity.GrahamN n 𝒞 → ∃ order, order.Nodup ∧ order.toFinset = 𝒞 ∧ HiddenChannelCapacity.RIPCover order

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (l : List (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.listCover l = HiddenChannelCapacity.coverU l.toFinset

statement.pretty:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic 𝒞 ↔
    ∀ (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι fun x => ZMod 2)),

        HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam → (∀ L ∈ fam, L.rel.Nonempty) → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam
